Title: Microarchitecture Security
About: The microarchitecture of computers has become more complex due to the performance optimizations. We explore the security side-effects that comes along with the performance benefits.

Title: DRAM Security
About: DRAM is prevalent in nearly all computing devices as a cost-effective way of storing data. We want to ensure that the underlying implementation is secured.

Title: Browser Security
About: Browsers are integral to the modern society. We evaluate the security of modern browsers and look for potential vulnerabiltiies introduced by the interaction of software and hardware.

Title: Keystroke Timing Attacks
About: The spatial layout of a keyboard enables adversaries to predict the input based on keystroke intervals. We aim to explore ways to extract and accurately reconstruct inputs.
